text.p: Oil product inventories held in independent tankage in the Amsterdam-Rotterdam-Antwerp area were estimated to be at the following levels currently, a week ago and a year ago, industry sources said.
All figures in thousands of tonnes:
Gas oil stocks rose slightly as product arrived from across the Atlantic and some IPE-related material lingered, but cargoes left for France and barges headed down the Rhine.
Gasoline stocks dipped as product left for Germany and the Med, but some barges arrived, probably to form a cargo.
Naphtha stock were steady with incoming coasters and outgoing material heading for the German chemical sector.
Fuel oil stocks slipped as little material arrived, but barges and bunker withdrawals continued.
Jet fuel was balanced, some moving to the gas oil pool, some to the aviation sector. -- Amsterdam Newsroom, +31 20 504 5004
